caption: Ancient Dimini, Dimini
composition: Concentric stone rings on the Neolithic mound · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The low mound at Dimini carries concentric rough-stone enclosure walls, with house foundations between the rings. A collapsed tholos entrance sits at the near edge, without an intact dome. The Thessalian plain surrounds the hill, and Pelion is a dark ridge to the east. The sky is clear, about 11.3°C. The site is unlit.
